title: Angie
creator: CrossFit
description: One hundred each of pull-ups, push-ups, sit-ups and squats, finishing all reps of one movement before starting the next. One of the original six Girls from 2003 and a pure test of bodyweight endurance, with the pull-ups deciding most people's time. Scale by cutting to 50 of each or swapping ring rows for the pull-ups.
